content.ascii:
[B] Diagram
|-- Shared contract: canvas, persistence, agents
|-- Identity
|   |-- diagramId: stable service identity
|   |-- revisionId: service revision identity
|   `-- id: local canvas content key; revision: integer
|-- content: deeply read-only DiagramContent
|   |-- revisionId, ascii, asciiSha256
|   `-- structure
|       |-- diagram
|       `-- tree: parserVersion, rootIds, nodes
|           `-- DiagramContentNode
|               |-- id, label, line, branch/start/end columns
|               `-- parentId, childIds, foldRanges
|-- sourceContext: deeply read-only
|   |-- contentHash
|   |-- optional binding: DiagramSourceBinding
|   |   |-- sourceId, repositoryIdentity
|   |   `-- corpus(kind/root/revision) + domainProfileId
|   |-- mappings: DiagramElementMapping[]
|   `-- evidence: entity ID -> record with sourceRanges
|-- optional jumps: read-only DiagramJump[]
|-- Content responsibility
|   |-- DiagramService alone creates/revises content
|   |-- buildDiagramContent owns canonical content construction
|   |   `-- ASCII + revision + parse -> hash and node IDs
|   `-- validateDiagram checks content, IDs and source joins
|       `-- source.contentHash must equal hash(content.ascii)
|-- Source query responsibility
|   |-- diagramSource -> queryDiagramSourceContext
|   |-- joins mapping.entityId/sourceRangeIndex to evidence/range
|   `-- exposes mappings(), entries(), forSelection(rect), search(query)
|       `-- read-only results include binding
`-- Tree projection helpers
    |-- visibleContentLines uses collapsed IDs + foldRanges
    |   `-- filters hidden lines; unknown IDs -> STALE_CONTENT_NODE
    `-- contentTreeNodes projects node records into parser-style nodes
